svg.title: Two trees grown from vertex 1 over steps k = 0, 1, 2: in the Erdos-Renyi graph process the number of new neighbors is B(N-1, lambda/N) and then B(N-4, lambda/N), and two vertices at step 1 can share a neighbor at step 2; in the branching process approximation every vertex has B(N, lambda/N) children and the result is always a tree.
